== Summary ==
[[Dean Irwin]], former Decipher director of sales, photographed for an ICv2 interview in 2020. Cropped to remove the black side bars of the published image; not resized.

* '''Source:''' Jim McLauchlin, [https://icv2.com/articles/columns/view/45201/business-3x3-dean-irwin-recently-enterplay Business 3x3: Dean Irwin, Recently of Enterplay], ICv2 (19 February 2020). The article's lead image; the article says of his first games job, "The job was with Decipher". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015183402/https://icv2.com/articles/columns/view/45201/business-3x3-dean-irwin-recently-enterplay Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027201306id_/https://icv2.com/images/uploads/4fbcfa9a2e84ab04576c1a18a3f80cb62d5765fb751af42bc4dd5698.jpg uploaded image] (Wayback SHA-1 matches the uncropped source).
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (published by ICv2).
* '''Date:''' published 19 February 2020
* '''Identification:''' the article is an interview with Dean Irwin and this is its only portrait.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a low-resolution portrait published by ICv2 with an article about him, used only to identify a former Decipher director of sales on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of him is known, and this use cannot harm any market for the original.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/84/Dean_Irwin_2020.jpg Internet Archive item].
